info.name: GlobeTrotter — Backend API
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the GlobeTrotter backend REST API (Express + TypeScript + Prisma + PostgreSQL).

────────────────────────────────────────────
HOW TO RUN
────────────────────────────────────────────
1. Start the server:  cd server && npm run dev   (http://localhost:5000)
2. Run requests top-to-bottom — every id (tripId, stopId, dayId, expenseId, shareSlug, ...) is AUTO-CAPTURED from responses into collection variables.
3. Auth: run Auth → Login once. The Bearer token is saved to {{accessToken}} automatically and applied to all protected routes.

────────────────────────────────────────────
QUICK FLOW
────────────────────────────────────────────
Health → Auth (Register + Login) → Countries/Cities/Activities (captures master data ids) → Trips → Days → Activities → Budget & Expenses → Dashboard & Saved → Sharing → Community → Admin → Errors.

NOTE: The API rate-limits to 100 requests per 15 min per IP. If you run the whole collection repeatedly, expect 429s near the end (RateLimitExceeded responses are included in the Errors folder).

item.name: Health — Sprint 1
item.description: Liveness and database connectivity checks. No authentication required.

request.description: GET /api/health — always-fast application liveness probe.
GET /api/health/db — pings PostgreSQL. Returns 503 when the database is unreachable (expected if Postgres is not running).

item.name: Auth
item.description:
Registration, login, current user and profile photo upload.

Run Login first — it stores {{accessToken}} used by every protected request in this collection.
Register does NOT return a token (users log in after sign-up), so after Register run Login with the same credentials.

request.description: POST /api/auth/register — creates a USER account (role is always USER). Email + username must be unique; {{$timestamp}} keeps reruns conflict-free. Optional fields: phone, city, country, bio, profilePhoto, language.
POST /api/auth/login — seeded demo credentials. Swap in your own registered credentials if you prefer. Saves data.accessToken into {{accessToken}} for the whole collection.
GET /api/auth/me — requires Authorization: Bearer {{accessToken}}.

PATCH /api/auth/profile — multipart/form-data. Attach a file to the profilePhoto field to upload an avatar (goes to Cloudinary). Without a file you may instead send raw JSON { "profilePhoto": "https://..." }.

item.name: Users
item.description: Self-service profile management. All routes require authentication.

request.description: GET /api/users/me
PATCH /api/users/me — all fields optional: firstName, lastName, username, phone, city, country, bio, profilePhoto, language.
PATCH /api/users/me/password — new password must be at least 8 characters. The demo body keeps the same password so reruns keep working.
DELETE /api/users/me — ⚠️ permanently deletes the logged-in account and cascades to its trips. Do NOT run with the demo account unless you can reseed.

item.name: Countries
item.description: Master data — countries. Public (no auth). Get All Countries captures {{countryId}} used by later flows.

request.description: GET /api/countries — full country list (seeded: India, France, Italy, Spain, Japan, UK, US, Thailand).
GET /api/countries/:id — includes the cities belonging to the country.

item.name: Cities
item.description: Master data — cities with search, filter, sort and pagination. Public. Get Cities captures {{cityId}}.

request.description: GET /api/cities — query params: search, countryId, region, sort (popularity | name | cost_asc | cost_desc), page (1..), limit (1..100).
GET /api/cities/:id — city detail including its activities.

item.name: Activities
item.description: Master data — bookable activities per city. Public. Get Activities captures {{activityId}}.

request.description: GET /api/activities — query params: search, cityId, type, minCost, maxCost, maxDuration, sort (name | cost_asc | cost_desc | duration_asc | duration_desc), page, limit.
GET /api/activities/:id

item.name: Trips
item.description:
Owned trip CRUD plus multi-city stops and itinerary days.

Recommended order: Create Trip → Create Stop → Create Day → Add Activity to Day → everything else. Create Trip captures {{tripId}}, Create Stop captures {{stopId}}, Create Day captures {{dayId}}, Add Activity captures {{tripActivityId}}.

Tip: to attach a cover photo, switch the Create Trip body to form-data and add a file field named coverPhoto.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Paris Getaway",
  "description": "A long weekend of art, food and the Seine.",
  "startDate": "2026-12-10",
  "endDate": "2026-12-14",
  "visibility": "PRIVATE"
}

request.description: POST /api/trips — creates an owned trip. Optional: coverPhoto (multipart file field). endDate must not be before startDate.
GET /api/trips — optional status filter (UPCOMING | ONGOING | COMPLETED). summary=true returns lightweight cards for dashboards.
POST /api/trips/:id/stops — adds a city stop. Stop dates must be inside the trip dates and must not overlap another stop.
GET /api/trips/:id/stops — ordered city stops.
GET /api/trips/:id/stops/:stopId
PATCH /api/trips/:id/stops/:stopId — optional cityId, startDate, endDate, notes.
PATCH /api/trips/:id/stops/reorder — stopIds must contain every stop of the trip exactly once (no duplicates). Reorder is atomic.
POST /api/trips/:id/days — one day per date (unique per trip); the date must fall within the trip range.
GET /api/trips/:id/days
GET /api/trips/:id/days/:dayId — includes scheduled activities.
PATCH /api/trips/:id/days/:dayId — optional date, title, notes.
POST /api/trips/:id/days/:dayId/activities — schedules a master activity on a day. Time uses HH:mm (24h); endTime cannot be before startTime; the activity's city must match a stop covering that date.
GET /api/trips/:id/itinerary — the fully ordered itinerary (stops → days → activities).
PATCH /api/trips/:id — optional name, description, coverPhoto, startDate, endDate, visibility.
GET /api/trips/:id — full trip with computed status.
POST /api/trips/:id/clone — deep-copies stops, days and scheduled activities. Expenses are not copied; the clone is PRIVATE.
DELETE /api/trips/:id/stops/:stopId — run LAST in the Trips flow (it removes the captured stop).
DELETE /api/trips/:id/days/:dayId — cascades to the day's scheduled activities.
DELETE /api/trips/:id — ⚠️ keep DISABLED in the runner; enables only when you want to remove the test trip. Cascades to stops, days, activities, expenses and share links.

item.name: Trip Activities
item.description: Update, reorder and remove activities already scheduled on itinerary days. Requires {{tripActivityId}} (and {{dayId}} for reorder).

request.description: PATCH /api/trip-activities/:id — optional startTime, endTime, customCost, notes, sequence.
PATCH /api/trip-activities/reorder — activityIds must list every activity of that day exactly once. Atomic reorder.
DELETE /api/trip-activities/:id — ⚠️ removes the captured scheduled activity; rerun Add Activity to Day afterwards if needed.

item.name: Budget & Expenses
item.description:
Planned budgets, categorized expenses, summaries, daily spending and the derived calendar.

Budget totals count only explicit TripExpense records — TripActivity.customCost is an itinerary estimate and is never double-counted.

request.description: PATCH /api/trips/:tripId/budget — amount must be positive; currency is a 3-letter code (INR, EUR, USD...).
POST /api/trips/:tripId/expenses — category: TRANSPORT | STAY | ACTIVITY | MEAL | OTHER. Optional tripStopId / tripActivityId links.
GET /api/trips/:tripId/expenses — optional category and date filters.
GET /api/trips/:tripId/expenses/:expenseId
PATCH /api/trips/:tripId/expenses/:expenseId — any field may be updated; body may be empty.
GET /api/trips/:tripId/budget — planned vs spent, per-category totals and over-budget detection.
GET /api/trips/:tripId/budget/daily — planned budget divided by inclusive trip days, with daily spend and alerts.
GET /api/trips/:tripId/calendar — activities grouped by date, derived from the ordered itinerary.
DELETE /api/trips/:tripId/expenses/:expenseId — run LAST in this folder (removes the captured expense).

item.name: Dashboard & Saved Destinations
item.description: Aggregated dashboard and the user's saved destinations list.

request.description: GET /api/dashboard — owned trips grouped by status, popular destinations and budget highlights.
POST /api/users/me/saved-destinations/:cityId — saving the same city twice returns 409 (duplicate protection).
GET /api/users/me/saved-destinations
DELETE /api/users/me/saved-destinations/:cityId

item.name: Sharing & Public Trips
item.description: Privacy-safe public sharing. Enable Share captures {{shareSlug}}; Public Trip is the only fully unauthenticated trip read.

request.description: POST /api/trips/:tripId/share — generates a share slug, flips the trip to PUBLIC and returns a ready-to-share URL. Captures {{shareSlug}}.

exec: pm.test('Public trip has stops and days', function () {

request.description: GET /api/public/trips/:shareSlug — read-only public itinerary. Private or unshared slugs return 404.

exec: pm.test('Copy created for current user', function () {

request.description: POST /api/public/trips/:shareSlug/copy — copies the public itinerary into the logged-in user's account (stops, days, activities; no expenses; PRIVATE).
DELETE /api/trips/:tripId/share — removes the share link; the public URL stops working immediately.

item.name: Community
item.description: Community posts with search, sorting and pagination. Listing and reading are public; creating, updating and deleting require auth and ownership. Create Post captures {{postId}}.

request.description: GET /api/community/posts — query params: search, sort (latest | oldest | updated), tripId, userId, page, limit. Author and attached trip are privacy-safe projections.
POST /api/community/posts — title (≤180) and content (≤10000) required; image URL and tripId optional. The attached trip must belong to you and be PUBLIC.
GET /api/community/posts/:postId
PATCH /api/community/posts/:postId — only the owner may update. Any of title, content, image, tripId.
DELETE /api/community/posts/:postId — only the owner may delete. Run LAST in this folder.

item.name: Admin
item.description:
Role-protected platform administration — requires an ADMIN account (seeded: admin@globetrotter.com / AdminSecret99!).

If you are logged in as a normal USER you will get 403 Forbidden — that is correct behaviour. List Users captures {{userId}}.

request.description: GET /api/admin/users — query params: search, role (USER | ADMIN), isActive (true | false), page, limit.
GET /api/admin/users/:userId — full user record plus trip statistics.
PATCH /api/admin/users/:userId/status — deactivating a user blocks their logins. Body: { "isActive": boolean }.
GET /api/admin/stats — user, trip and expense totals for the admin overview.
GET /api/admin/popular-cities — most-visited cities across all trips.
GET /api/admin/popular-activities — most-scheduled activities.
GET /api/admin/engagement — community and platform engagement metrics.
GET /api/admin/trends — signups, trips and expenses over time for trend charts.

item.name: Errors — Negative Testing
item.description: Deliberate failure cases proving the API responds with the standard error envelope { success: false, message, error: { code } } and correct status codes.

request.description: POST /api/auth/login — invalid credentials return 401 UNAUTHORIZED.
GET /api/trips without a Bearer token — protected routes must reject anonymous access.
POST /api/auth/register — malformed body returns 400 with error.details listing every failing field.
GET /api/trips/99999999 — a trip that does not exist or belongs to another user returns 404 (ownership is not leaked).
GET /api/definitely-not-a-route — unmatched routes return a structured 404, not an HTML error page.
GET /api/admin/stats with a non-admin token (or no token) — role-based access control must block it. Login as the seeded admin to see 200.
